suggested_requirements.text: The system shall provide a graphical color chooser.
The system shall provide a color translator for converting old paint scheme numbers to new scheme numbers.
The system shall provide a tool to locate colors near a given paint number and collection.
The system shall provide a color search engine to locate colors based on paint name, number, or color value.
The system shall provide a session-persistent user color palette to store recent color searches.
The system shall provide an administrative interface to update, add, and delete paint information.
The system shall allow administrative users to add other administrative users.
The system shall allow users to upload images for color matching.
The system shall provide an error reporting utility.
The system shall provide on-line help and an online tutorial.
The system shall process color search queries in sub-second time on the server.
The system shall process updates to paint and collection information in real-time.
The system shall retain full functionality with a keyboard input device only.
The system shall provide a task-based screen interface with consistent navigation.
The system shall protect administrative access permissions with secure authentication.
The system shall keep user-specified color palettes private.
The system shall implement privacy and security measures on par with industry standards.
The system shall be a web-based application.
The system shall be integrated into the ABC Paint website.
The system shall remove user data from the server after 30 days.
